note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors. No contest took place; the divisions listed were filled by sole nomination and the round is filed on the rural districts' polling day, Thursday 2 June 1927 (queue nominal 26 May). No nominations were received for Ballymacbrennan, Breda, Carryduff, Edenderry or Hillsborough, and the nomination for Maze was declared invalid. Sole nomination; returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
